# Range

By Epstein.

The ending surprised me, I did not see it coming. Favourite idea: write things down before you trust your memory. The writing is clear and the examples are memorable.

A good book for a long flight. Key takeaway: decide what not to do before deciding what to do. It changed how I run the weekly review.

I would give it four stars out of five.
